result.summary: Read git diff master...HEAD directly (55 files, e47760a is the substantive commit). All 8 file-move rows in docs/agents/design/REQ-007.md section 2 are present as 100%-similarity renames in `git diff --summary` (src/, messages/, public/, next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, next-env.d.ts, package.json -> apps/web/package.json) — 100% content-identity rename detection is the available git evidence for git-mv-not-delete-recreate, and no move shows a paired delete+add with content differences. Root package.json matches design section 3 exactly: name 'aiqadam-next' (the design's own recommended default from its open question), private:true, workspaces:['apps/*'] only (no premature packages/*), and dev/build/lint/start all delegate via `npm run X -w apps/web`. apps/web/package.json matches design section 4 exactly and is byte-identical in content to master's former root package.json (diffed name/version/private/scripts/dependencies/devDependencies field-by-field against `git show master:package.json` — identical). package-lock.json was regenerated (not moved) per design section 5 — new root entry plus an apps/web workspace member entry, as specified. Out-of-scope boundary (section 6) verified by diffing each path individually against master: Dockerfile, deploy/, .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml, README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .gitignore all produced empty diffs (byte-identical). docs/agents/requirements.yaml's only change is REQ-007's own status field (pending->in_progress); REQ-001a..REQ-006 entries untouched (confirmed via full diff, only one +/- line pair). No apps/bot/ or packages/ created. Remaining diff is design/issue artifacts (docs/agents/design/REQ-007.md, docs/issues/ISS-0004.yaml), requirement_status.yaml's normal 'started' bookkeeping event, and WF02-REQ-007 handoff files/orchestrator.log growth (append-only, growth only) — all in scope for a WF-02 build step, nothing unaccounted for. Consistent with decisions/0003-events-bot-subproject.md's 'Layout: the site moves to apps/web' section (apps/web/ described as 'the existing Next.js site (moved from the repo root)', matching this diff exactly). ISS-0004 independently confirmed accurate: .gitignore's `/.next/` entry (leading slash, root-anchored) does not match apps/web/.next/, so the workspace's build output is no longer gitignored; correctly filed as MINOR and correctly not fixed here since .gitignore is explicitly out of scope per design section 6. No other similarly-dangling gap found.
